scientific_integrity: Direct proof by interval splitting and exact three-variable interval tests; finite verification is corroborating rather than exhaustive; historical-priority comparison remains qualified; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite, strict, uncoloured, oriented cyclic orders with at least three points in pure ternary cyclic-order signature; ordinary FO without counting. No result for successor, constants, colours, other signatures, or formulas with free variables.
title: Sharp quantifier-rank cutoff and three-variable completeness for finite cyclic orders
